other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage during Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is calculated and applied to the entire training set before cross-validation is performed. This leaks the target values of the CV validation folds into the CV training folds through the encoded features, resulting in overly optimistic cross-validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Flawed Manual One-Hot Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies `pd.get_dummies` with `drop_first=True` separately on the train, validation, and test sets. If the validation or test sets lack the training set's baseline category, a different category is dropped. This causes valid categories to be misaligned and erroneously treated as the training set's baseline by the model.

However, it introduces target leakage during cross-validation by applying target encoding before the CV splits.
